fields.name: DMAOS
fields.text: 1: one DMA trigger is issued on the TCC cycle after a TCC_CTRLBSET_CMD_DMAOS command; 0: a DMA trigger is issued every TCC cycle. Not synchronized.

fields.name: MSYNC
fields.text: Set it to make this TCC's counting follow its Host TCC. Client instances only. Not synchronized.

values.text: Counter driven by the Host TCC.

fields.name: ALOCK
fields.text: Picks whether overflow, underflow and re-trigger events set CTRLB.LUPD. Not synchronized.

values.text: CTRLB.LUPD is left alone by overflow, underflow and re-trigger events.
Each overflow, underflow or re-trigger event sets CTRLB.LUPD.

fields.name: PRESCSYNC
fields.text: Picks when a re-trigger event reloads or clears the counter, and whether it also resets the prescaler. Not synchronized. 0x0 GCLK: counter reloaded or reset on the next GCLK_TCCx, prescaler untouched. 0x1 PRESC: counter reloaded or reset on the next prescaled clock, prescaler untouched. 0x2 RESYNC: counter reloaded or reset on the next GCLK_TCCx and the prescaler counter reset. 0x3: reserved.

values.name: GCLK
values.text: Counter reloaded or reset on the next GCLK_TCCx.

values.name: PRESC
values.text: Counter reloaded or reset on the next prescaled clock.

values.name: RESYNC
values.text: Counter reloaded or reset on the next GCLK_TCCx; prescaler counter reset.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Keeps the TCC running in Standby sleep mode. Not synchronized.

fields.name: PRESCALER
fields.text: Divides GCLK_TCCx to clock the counter. Not synchronized.

fields.name: RESOLUTION
fields.text: Turns on dithering to raise the TCC's resolution. Not synchronized.

values.name: DITH4
values.text: Dither over 16 PWM frames; PER[3:0] and CCx[3:0] pick the pattern.

values.name: DITH5
values.text: Dither over 32 PWM frames; PER[4:0] and CCx[4:0] pick the pattern.

values.name: DITH6
values.text: Dither over 64 PWM frames; PER[5:0] and CCx[5:0] pick the pattern.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the TCC on or off. The written value reads back at once and SYNCBUSY.ENABLE is set; the TCC changes state after synchronization, when SYNCBUSY.ENABLE clears.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Writing 1 returns every TCC register except DBGCTRL to its reset value and disables the TCC; writing 0 does nothing. A 1 here wins over every other write in the same access, which is dropped. Poll SYNCBUSY.SWRST to know when the reset is done; until it clears, registers and bits without SWRST cannot be accessed.

registers.name: CTRLBCLR
registers.title: Control B Clear
notes: Writing 1 to a bit clears it in CTRLB without a read-modify-write; the change also shows in CTRLBSET.

fields.name: CMD
fields.text: Clears a pending command: 1 in any bit clears it, 0 does nothing.

fields.name: IDXCMD
fields.text: Forces cycle A or cycle B in RAMP2 and RAMP2A operation. The command runs on the timer/counter update condition, which updates STATUS.IDX and clears IDXCMD. 1 in any bit clears the pending command; 0 does nothing.

values.name: DISABLE
values.text: DISABLE: no command; IDX alternates between cycle A and cycle B.

values.name: SET
values.text: Set IDX: next cycle is cycle B.

values.name: CLEAR
values.text: Clear IDX: next cycle is cycle A.

values.name: HOLD
values.text: Hold IDX: next cycle repeats the current one.

fields.name: ONESHOT
fields.text: One-shot operation, in which the TCC stops counting at the next overflow, underflow or stop command. Writing 1 turns one-shot off; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Counter reloads on overflow or underflow and keeps running.
Counter stops at the next overflow or underflow.

fields.name: LUPD
fields.text: Locks the hardware UPDATE of buffered registers from their buffers. Writing 1 clears LUPD, allowing updates on the hardware UPDATE condition; writing 0 does nothing. No effect while input capture is enabled.

values.text: On hardware update, CCBx, PERB, PGVB and PGEB are copied into CCx, PER, PGV and PGE.
Hardware update leaves CCx, PER, PGV and PGE unchanged; CCBx, PERB, PGVB and PGEB stay in their buffers.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Counting direction. Writing 1 clears the bit so the counter counts up; writing 0 does nothing.

registers.name: CTRLBSET
registers.title: Control B Set
notes: Writing 1 to a bit sets it in CTRLB without a read-modify-write; the change also shows in CTRLBCLR.

fields.name: CMD
fields.text: Issues software re-trigger, stop and other commands. A nonzero write issues the command, executed on the next prescaled GCLK_TCCx cycle; zero does nothing; the field reads back zero once the command has run. The command needs synchronization: write CTRLBSET.CMD, wait for SYNCBUSY.CTRLB to read 0, then wait for CTRLBSET.CMD to read 0.

fields.name: IDXCMD
fields.text: Forces cycle A or cycle B in RAMP2 and RAMP2A operation. The command runs on the timer/counter update condition, which updates STATUS.IDX and clears IDXCMD. A valid nonzero write sets the command; zero does nothing.

values.name: DISABLE
values.text: No command; IDX alternates between cycle A and cycle B.

values.name: SET
values.text: Set IDX: next cycle is cycle B.

values.name: CLEAR
values.text: Clear IDX: next cycle is cycle A.

values.name: HOLD
values.text: Hold IDX: next cycle repeats the current one.

fields.name: ONESHOT
fields.text: One-shot operation, in which the TCC stops counting at the next overflow, underflow or stop command. Writing 1 turns one-shot on; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: Counter stops at the next overflow or underflow.

fields.name: LUPD
fields.text: Locks the hardware UPDATE of buffered registers from their buffers, so every buffer can be loaded before an update takes them; clear it afterwards to unlock. Writing 1 sets LUPD and blocks updates on the hardware UPDATE condition; writing 0 does nothing. No effect while input capture is enabled.

values.text: On hardware update, CCBx, PERB, PGVB and PGEB are copied into CCx, PER, PGV and PGE.
Hardware update leaves CCx, PER, PGV and PGE unchanged; CCBx, PERB, PGVB and PGEB stay in their buffers.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Counting direction. Writing 1 sets the bit so the counter counts down; writing 0 does nothing. Before counting down, load COUNT with the TOP value (PER or CC0, by mode).

fields.name: CC
fields.text: One bit per existing Compare/Capture channel x: set when a CCx write starts crossing clock domains, cleared when that synchronization finishes.

fields.name: PER
fields.text: Set when a PER write starts crossing clock domains; cleared when that synchronization finishes.

fields.name: WAVE
fields.text: Set when a WAVE write starts crossing clock domains; cleared when that synchronization finishes.

fields.name: PATT
fields.text: Set when a PATTERN write starts crossing clock domains; cleared when that synchronization finishes.

fields.name: COUNT
fields.text: Set when a COUNT synchronization between clock domains starts; cleared when it finishes.

fields.name: STATUS
fields.text: Set when a STATUS synchronization between clock domains starts; cleared when it finishes.

fields.name: CTRLB
fields.text: Set when a CTRLB synchronization between clock domains starts; cleared when it finishes.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Set when an ENABLE write starts crossing clock domains; cleared when that synchronization finishes.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Set when a SWRST write starts crossing clock domains; cleared when that synchronization finishes.

fields.name: FILTERVAL
fields.text: Filter applied to the MCEx (x=0,1) event input. Must be 0 when MCEx is used as a synchronous event.

fields.name: BLANKVAL
fields.text: Length of the fault-input blanking: after the selected waveform edge, the fault input is ignored for BLANKVAL prescaled GCLK_TCCx periods. FCTRLn.BLANK turns blanking on and picks the edge.

fields.name: BLANKPRESC
fields.text: Multiplies the BLANKVAL time base by 64.

values.text: Blanking lasts BLANKVAL prescaled GCLK_TCCx periods.
Blanking lasts BLANKVAL x 64 prescaled GCLK_TCCx periods.

fields.name: CAPTURE
fields.text: Picks what recoverable Fault n captures and when it raises its interrupt or event.

values.name: CAPT
values.text: On each rising edge of a valid Fault n, the counter is captured into the CHSEL[1:0] channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on every new capture.

values.name: CAPTMIN
values.text: On a rising edge of a valid Fault n, the counter is captured into the CHSEL[1:0] channel only if COUNT is below the last stored CC value; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local minimum.

values.name: CAPTMAX
values.text: On a rising edge of a valid Fault n, the counter is captured into the CHSEL[1:0] channel only if COUNT is above the last stored CC value; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local maximum.

values.name: LOCMIN
values.text: On each rising edge of a valid Fault n, the counter is captured into the CHSEL[1:0] channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local minimum.

values.name: LOCMAX
values.text: On each rising edge of a valid Fault n, the counter is captured into the CHSEL[1:0] channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local maximum.

values.name: DERIV0
values.text: On each rising edge of a valid Fault n, the counter is captured into the CHSEL[1:0] channel; INTFLAG.FAULTn is set on each local maximum or minimum.

values.name: CAPTMARK
values.text: Capture with the ramp index as the MSB.

fields.name: CHSEL
fields.text: Channel that recoverable Fault n captures into.

fields.name: HALT
fields.text: Halt action taken on recoverable Fault n.

fields.name: RESTART
fields.text: Turns on the restart action for Fault n.

fields.name: BLANK
fields.text: Point from which recoverable Fault n is blanked.

values.name: START
values.text: From the start of the ramp period.

values.name: RISE
values.text: From the waveform output's rising edge.

values.name: FALL
values.text: From the waveform output's falling edge.

values.name: BOTH
values.text: From every toggle of the waveform output.

fields.name: QUAL
fields.text: Turns on qualification of the recoverable Fault n input.

values.text: Fault input is not masked by the CMPx value.
Fault input is masked while the output is at its inactive level (CMPx = 0).

fields.name: KEEP
fields.text: Turns on the keep action for Fault n.

values.text: Fault n state ends when the fault input releases.
Fault n state ends at the end of the TCC cycle.

fields.name: SRC
fields.text: TCC event input used as recoverable Fault n. When it is used this way, the event system channel feeding MCEx must route the event asynchronously.

values.name: ALTFAULT
values.text: Fault A or B state as it stood when the last period ended.

fields.name: DTHS
fields.text: High-side dead time, in GCLK_TCCx cycles.

fields.name: DTLS
fields.text: Low-side dead time, in GCLK_TCCx cycles.

fields.name: DTIENx
fields.text: One bit per output matrix x: turns on its dead-time insertion generator, which drives output [x] with the low-side waveform and output [x+WO_NUM/2] with the high-side waveform in place of the output matrix.

values.text: Outputs [x] and [x+WO_NUM/2] are driven with dead time from matrix output [x].

fields.name: OTMX
fields.text: Output matrix: how the TCC waveform outputs are routed to the port pins.

fields.name: FILTERVAL1
fields.text: Filter applied to the TCE1 event input. Must be 0x0 when TCE1 is a synchronous event.

fields.name: FILTERVAL0
fields.text: Filter applied to the TCE0 event input. Must be 0x0 when TCE0 is a synchronous event.

fields.name: INVEN
fields.text: One bit per output x: 1 inverts WO[x], 0 leaves it uninverted.

fields.name: NRV
fields.text: One bit per output x: the level an enabled override output takes under a non-recoverable fault.

fields.name: NRE
fields.text: One bit per output x: lets NRVx override that output under a non-recoverable fault.

values.text: Output goes tri-state on a non-recoverable fault.
Output goes to the NRVx level on a non-recoverable fault.

fields.name: FDDBD
fields.text: 1 makes a break request from the on-chip debug system trigger a non-recoverable fault; 0 (reset) leaves this protection off. A software reset does not change it; software is not to change it while the TCC is enabled.

values.text: No fault while the TCC is halted in Debug mode.
Non-recoverable fault, with FAULTD set, while the TCC is halted in Debug mode.

fields.name: DBGRUN
fields.text: Picks whether the TCC runs while the device is halted in Debug mode. A software reset does not change it; software is not to change it while the TCC is enabled.

values.text: Halted with the device in Debug mode.
Keeps running with the device halted in Debug mode.

fields.name: MCEO
fields.text: One bit per channel x: generates an event on every match or capture of that channel.

values.text: No match/capture event from channel x.
An event on every compare or capture of channel x.

fields.name: MCEI
fields.text: One bit per channel x: accepts incoming match or capture events to CCx.

fields.name: TCEI
fields.text: One bit per input x: lets event input x into the TCC.

fields.name: TCINV
fields.text: One bit per input x: inverts event input x.

fields.name: CNTEO
fields.text: Turns on the counter cycle event, generated at the start or end of a counter cycle as CNTSEL[1:0] selects.

values.text: Counter cycle event generated as CNTSEL[1:0] selects.

fields.name: TRGEO
fields.text: Turns on an event each time the counter retriggers.

values.text: An event on every counter retrigger.

fields.name: OVFEO
fields.text: Turns on an event each time the counter reaches TOP or ZERO.

values.text: An event on every overflow or underflow.

fields.name: CNTSEL
fields.text: Part of the counter cycle on which the counter event output is generated.

values.name: BEGIN
values.text: At the start of every counter cycle.

values.name: END
values.text: At the end of every counter cycle.

values.name: BOUNDARY
values.text: At the start of the first counter cycle and the end of the last.

fields.name: EVACT1
fields.text: Action taken on the TCE1 event input.

values.name: DIR
values.text: Asynchronous: event sets the count direction.

values.name: PPW
values.text: Period into CC0, pulse width into CC1.

values.name: PWP
values.text: Period into CC1, pulse width into CC0.

fields.name: EVACT0
fields.text: Action taken on the TCE0 event input.

values.name: COUNT
values.text: Asynchronous: counts while the event is active.

registers.name: INTENCLR
registers.title: Interrupt Enable Clear
notes: Clears interrupt enables without a read-modify-write; the change also shows in INTENSET.

fields.name: MCx
fields.text: One bit per channel x: writing 1 turns off the interrupt for Match or Capture Channel x; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULT1
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Non-Recoverable Fault 1 interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULT0
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Non-Recoverable Fault 0 interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTB
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Recoverable Fault B interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTA
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Recoverable Fault A interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DFS
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Debug Fault State interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UFS
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Non-Recoverable Update Fault interrupt; 0 does nothing. Present on variant L devices only.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Error interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CNT
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Counter interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TRG
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Retrigger interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Writing 1 disables the Overflow interrupt; 0 does nothing.

registers.name: INTENSET
registers.title: Interrupt Enable Set
notes: Sets interrupt enables without a read-modify-write; the change also shows in INTENCLR.

fields.name: MCx
fields.text: One bit per channel x: writing 1 turns on the interrupt for Match or Capture Channel x; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULT1
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Non-Recoverable Fault 1 interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULT0
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Non-Recoverable Fault 0 interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTB
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Recoverable Fault B interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTA
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Recoverable Fault A interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DFS
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Debug Fault State interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UFS
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Non-Recoverable Update Fault interrupt; 0 does nothing. Present on variant L devices only.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Error interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CNT
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Counter interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TRG
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Retrigger interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Writing 1 enables the Overflow interrupt; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: MCx
fields.text: One bit per channel x: set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after a compare match, or once CCx holds a valid capture. Writing 1 clears it, 0 does nothing; in capture operation a read of CCx also clears it.

fields.name: FAULT1
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after Non-Recoverable Fault 1 occurs. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULT0
fields.text: Non-Recoverable Fault 0 interrupt flag. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTB
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after Recoverable Fault B occurs. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: FAULTA
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after Recoverable Fault A occurs. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DFS
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after a Debug Fault State occurs. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: UFS
fields.text: Set when the RAMP index changes while CTRLBSET.LUPD is set. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing. Present on variant L devices only.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Set when a new capture arrives on a channel whose Match or Capture Channel x flag is still 1, leaving the new capture nowhere to go. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CNT
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after each counter event. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TRG
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after the counter retriggers. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Set one CLK_TCC_COUNT cycle after an overflow. Writing 1 clears it; 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CMPx
fields.text: One bit per channel x: the current output compare value of channel x.

fields.name: CCBUFVx
fields.text: One bit per channel x. Compare channel: set by a write to CCBUFx; cleared by an UPDATE condition, or by writing 1 while CTRLB.LUPD is set. Capture channel: set when CCBUFx holds a valid capture; cleared by a read of CCx.

fields.name: FAULTx
fields.text: One bit per input x: set by hardware when non-recoverable Fault x occurs; cleared by writing 1 while the matching FAULTxIN bit is low. After it clears, counting resumes from the last COUNT value; to restart from BOTTOM, issue the restart command (CTRLBSET.CMD) before clearing it.

fields.name: FAULTB
fields.text: Set by hardware when recoverable Fault B occurs. Cleared by hardware when the Fault B action resumes, or by writing 1 while FAULTBIN is low. With the software halt selected (FAULTB.HALT=SW), clearing it releases the timer/counter.

fields.name: FAULTA
fields.text: Set by hardware when recoverable Fault A occurs. Cleared by hardware when the Fault A action resumes, or by writing 1 while FAULTAIN is low. With the software halt selected (FAULTA.HALT=SW), clearing it releases the timer/counter.

fields.name: FAULT1IN
fields.text: Reads 1 while Non-Recoverable Fault 1 input is active.

fields.name: FAULT0IN
fields.text: Reads 1 while Non-Recoverable Fault 0 input is active.

fields.name: FAULTBIN
fields.text: Reads 1 while Recoverable Fault B input is active.

fields.name: FAULTAIN
fields.text: Reads 1 while Recoverable Fault A input is active.

fields.name: PERBUFV
fields.text: Set by a write to PERBUF; cleared by hardware on an UPDATE condition with CTRLB.LUPD set, or by writing 1.

fields.name: PATTBUFV
fields.text: Set by a write to PATTBUF; cleared by hardware on an UPDATE condition with CTRLB.LUPD set, or by writing 1.

fields.name: SLAVE
fields.text: Reads 1 while the TCC is in Client mode; it follows CTRLA.MSYNC.

fields.name: DFS
fields.text: Set by hardware in Debug mode when DBGCTRL.FDDBD is set; cleared by writing 1 once the TCC is out of Debug mode. While set, the counter is halted and the outputs follow DRVCTRL.NRE and DRVCTRL.NRV.

fields.name: UFS
fields.text: Hardware sets it when CTRLBSET.LUPD is set and the RAMP index changes; cleared by writing 1. While set, the outputs follow DRVCTRL.NRE and DRVCTRL.NRV.

fields.name: IDX
fields.text: In RAMP2 and RAMP2A operation, reads 0 during cycle A and 1 during cycle B; in RAMP1 operation it always reads 0.

fields.name: STOP
fields.text: Set when the TCC stops, from a STOP command, or from an UPDATE condition while one-shot operation is on (CTRLBSET.ONESHOT=1); cleared on the next counter increment or decrement.

registers.name: COUNT
registers.title: Counter Value
notes: Before each read, synchronize it by writing CTRLBSET.CMD = READSYNC.

fields.name: COUNT
fields.text: The counter value. In 16-bit configuration the unused upper bits read 0. The field sits at bits [23:m], where m follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE 23:0, 0x1 DITH4 23:4, 0x2 DITH5 23:5, 0x3 DITH6 23:6.

fields.name: PGV
fields.text: One bit per waveform output: the level the pattern generator drives.

fields.name: PGE
fields.text: One bit per waveform output: 1 replaces that SWAP output with its PGVn value.

fields.name: SWAP
fields.text: One bit per DTI output pair x: swaps outputs [x] and [x+WO_NUM/2]. The DTIxEN settings do not change the swap.

fields.name: POL
fields.text: One bit per channel x: polarity of the output for single-slope and dual-slope PWM.

values.text: Output starts at ~DIR and goes to DIR on a match of CCx.
Output starts at DIR and goes to ~DIR on a match of CCx.
Output goes to ~DIR on a match of CCx.
Output goes to DIR on a match of CCx.

fields.name: CICCEN
fields.text: One bit per channel x of the first four Compare/Capture channels: turns on the circular compare buffer, copying CCx back on each UPDATE condition.

fields.name: CIPEREN
fields.text: Turns on the circular period buffer: on each UPDATE condition PER is copied back into PERB.

fields.name: RAMP
fields.text: Ramp operation. Not synchronized.

fields.name: WAVEGEN
fields.text: Waveform generation operation, which sets the TOP value and whether frequency or PWM output is made. Not synchronized. 0x0 NFRQ normal frequency: TOP is PER, update at TOP/zero, output toggles on match, flag/event at TOP up and zero down. 0x1 MFRQ match frequency: TOP is CC0, otherwise as NFRQ. 0x2 NPWM normal PWM: TOP is PER, update at TOP/zero, output set on match and cleared on update, flag/event at TOP up and zero down. 0x3: reserved. 0x4 DSCRITICAL and 0x5 DSBOTTOM dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at zero, output ~DIR on match, flag/event at zero. 0x6 DSBOTH dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at TOP and zero, output ~DIR on match, flag/event at TOP and zero. 0x7 DSTOP dual-slope PWM: TOP is PER, update at zero, output ~DIR on match, flag/event at TOP.

values.name: NFRQ
values.text: Normal frequency: TOP is PER, output toggles on match, flag at TOP up and zero down.

values.name: MFRQ
values.text: Match frequency: TOP is CC0, output toggles on match, flag at TOP up and zero down.

values.name: NPWM
values.text: Normal PWM: TOP is PER, output set on match and cleared on update, flag at TOP up and zero down.

values.name: DSCRITICAL
values.text: Dual-slope PWM, TOP is PER, update at zero, output ~DIR on match, flag at zero.

values.name: DSBOTTOM
values.text: Dual-slope PWM, TOP is PER, update at zero, output ~DIR on match, flag at zero.

values.name: DSBOTH
values.text: Dual-slope PWM, TOP is PER, update at TOP and zero, output ~DIR on match, flag at TOP and zero.

values.name: DSTOP
values.text: Dual-slope PWM, TOP is PER, update at zero, output ~DIR on match, flag at TOP.

registers.name: PER
registers.title: Period Value
notes: The register's reset value is also given as 0xFFFFFFFF.

fields.name: PER
fields.text: The period count. In 16-bit configuration the unused upper bits read 0. The field sits at bits [23:m], where m follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE 23:0, 0x1 DITH4 23:4, 0x2 DITH5 23:5, 0x3 DITH6 23:6.

fields.name: DITHER
fields.text: Extra cycles added to the PWM period over every 64 PWM frames. The field is bits [n:0], where n follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE none, 0x1 DITH4 3:0, 0x2 DITH5 4:0, 0x3 DITH6 5:0.

registers.name: CCx
registers.title: Compare/Capture Channel x
notes: 16- or 24-bit value CCx. In capture operation it is the second buffer level and the CPU and DMA access point; in compare operation it is compared continuously with the counter, and the comparator output normally drives the waveforms. An UPDATE condition loads it from CCBUFx. In match frequency operation CC0 sets the counter period.

fields.name: CC
fields.text: Channel x compare or capture value. In 16-bit configuration the unused upper bits read 0. The field sits at bits [23:m], where m follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE 23:0, 0x1 DITH4 23:4, 0x2 DITH5 23:5, 0x3 DITH6 23:6.

fields.name: DITHER
fields.text: Extra cycles added to the PWM pulse width over every 64 PWM frames. The field is bits [n:0], where n follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE none, 0x1 DITH4 3:0, 0x2 DITH5 4:0, 0x3 DITH6 5:0.

fields.name: PGVB
fields.text: Buffer for PGV; with double buffering, a valid value here moves into PGV on an UPDATE condition.

fields.name: PGEB
fields.text: Buffer for PGE; with double buffering, a valid value here moves into PGE on an UPDATE condition.

registers.name: PERBUF
registers.title: Period Buffer Value
notes: The register's reset value is also given as 0xFFFFFFFF.

fields.name: PERBUF
fields.text: Period buffer; its value moves into PER on an UPDATE condition. In 16-bit configuration the unused upper bits read 0. The field sits at bits [23:m], where m follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE 23:0, 0x1 DITH4 23:4, 0x2 DITH5 23:5, 0x3 DITH6 23:6.

fields.name: DITHERBUF
fields.text: Buffer for PER.DITHER; with double buffering, it moves into PER.DITHER on an UPDATE condition. The field is bits [n:0], where n follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE none, 0x1 DITH4 3:0, 0x2 DITH5 4:0, 0x3 DITH6 5:0.

registers.name: CCBUF
registers.title: Channel x Compare/Capture Buffer Value
notes: CCBUFx is copied into CCx when the TCC updates.

fields.name: CCBUF
fields.text: Channel x buffer for CCx. A CPU or DMA access to it changes the matching CCBUFVx status bit. In 16-bit configuration the unused upper bits read 0. The field sits at bits [23:m], where m follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE 23:0, 0x1 DITH4 23:4, 0x2 DITH5 23:5, 0x3 DITH6 23:6.

fields.name: DITHERBUF
fields.text: Buffer for CCx.DITHER; with double buffering, it moves into CCx.DITHER on an UPDATE condition. The field is bits [n:0], where n follows CTRLA.RESOLUTION: 0x0 NONE none, 0x1 DITH4 3:0, 0x2 DITH5 4:0, 0x3 DITH6 5:0.

fields.name: RXEN
fields.text: Turns the Rx Serializer on (1) or off (0).

fields.name: TXEN
fields.text: Turns the Tx Serializer on (1) or off (0).

fields.name: CKENx
fields.text: One bit per Clock Unit x: 1 turns that clock unit on, 0 turns it off.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the I2S module on (1) or off (0).

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: A 1 returns every register to its reset value and leaves the module disabled; a 0 does nothing. A 1 here wins over every other bit written in the same access, which is dropped. The I2S generic clocks have to be running before the reset is started so that every clock domain gets reset.

fields.name: MCKOUTDIV
fields.text: The Host Clock n output is the clock chosen by MCKSEL divided by MCKOUTDIV + 1.

fields.name: MCKDIV
fields.text: Serial Clock n is Host Clock n divided by MCKDIV + 1.

fields.name: MCKOUTINV
fields.text: Inverts Host Clock n on its way to the output pin.

fields.name: MCKEN
fields.text: Turns on the division and output of Host Clock n. In Client mode it does not turn on the clock output.

values.text: Host Clock n division and output off.
Host Clock n division and output on.

fields.name: MCKSEL
fields.text: Picks where Host Clock n comes from.

fields.name: SCKOUTINV
fields.text: Inverts Serial Clock n on its way to the output pin.

fields.name: SCKSEL
fields.text: Picks where Serial Clock n comes from.

fields.name: FSOUTINV
fields.text: Inverts Frame Sync n on its way to the output pin.

fields.name: FSINV
fields.text: Inverts Frame Sync n before the clock unit uses it.

fields.name: FSSEL
fields.text: Picks where Frame Sync n comes from.

fields.name: BITDELAY
fields.text: Delay between the Frame Sync edge and the first data bit.

fields.name: FSWIDTH
fields.text: Length of each Frame Sync output pulse. Outside Burst mode, an enabled Clock Unit n runs continuously, with Frame Sync pulses and data samples at a steady rate. In Burst mode each Frame Sync pulse is one bit long, comes only when a data transfer is asked for, and starts one transfer. Burst mode does not support the compact stereo formats (16C and 8C).

values.name: SLOT
values.text: One slot long; the I2S default.

values.name: BURST
values.text: Burst mode: each data sample gets its own one-bit Frame Sync pulse, sent only on a transfer request.

fields.name: NBSLOTS
fields.text: A frame of Clock Unit n holds NBSLOTS + 1 slots.

fields.name: SLOTSIZE
fields.text: Number of bits in each slot of Clock Unit n.

fields.name: TXURx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 clears the Transmit Underrun x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: TXRDYx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 clears the Transmit Ready x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: RXORx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 clears the Receive Overrun x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: RXRDYx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 clears the Receive Ready x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: TXURx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 sets the Transmit Underrun x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: TXRDYx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 sets the Transmit Ready x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: RXORx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 sets the Receive Overrun x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: RXRDYx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: writing 1 sets the Receive Ready x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing. Reads back whether the interrupt is enabled.

fields.name: TXURx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: set when Sequencer x has a transmit underrun; raises an interrupt when INTENCLR/SET.TXURx is 1. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: TXRDYx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: set when Sequencer x can take another data word to send; raises an interrupt when INTENCLR/SET.TXRDYx is 1. A write to DATAx or a 1 written here clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RXORx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: set when Sequencer x has a receive overrun; raises an interrupt when INTENCLR/SET.RXORx is 1. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RXRDYx
fields.text: One bit per sequencer x: set when Sequencer x has taken in a new data word; raises an interrupt when INTENCLR/SET.RXRDYx is 1. A read of DATAx or a 1 written here clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: RXDATA
fields.text: Reads 1 while the RXDATA register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: TXDATA
fields.text: Reads 1 while the TXDATA register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: RXEN
fields.text: Reads 1 while CTRLA.RXEN is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: TXEN
fields.text: Reads 1 while CTRLA.TXEN is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: CKENx
fields.text: Reads 1 while CTRLA.CKENx (one bit per clock unit x) is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Reads 1 while CTRLA.ENABLE is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Reads 1 while CTRLA.SWRST is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: DMA
fields.text: Whether even- and odd-numbered slots share one DMA channel or each have their own.

values.name: MULTIPLE
values.text: A DMA channel for each data channel.

fields.name: MONO
fields.text: Mono mode.

values.name: MONO
values.text: Left-channel data is copied to the right channel.

fields.name: SLOTDISx
fields.text: One bit per slot x: lets individual slots of each transmit frame be left out.

values.text: Slot x carries no data and is driven as TXDEFAULT sets.

fields.name: BITREV
fields.text: Order of the data bits within the word, set in the Formatting Unit.

fields.name: EXTEND
fields.text: Bit value the Formatting Unit uses to pad out data samples.

fields.name: WORDADJ
fields.text: Whether the Formatting Unit places data samples at the left or right of the word.

fields.name: DATASIZE
fields.text: Bits per data sample. In 8-bit compact stereo two 8-bit samples share bits 15:0 of DATAm; in 16-bit compact stereo two 16-bit samples share bits 31:0 of DATAm.

fields.name: SLOTADJ
fields.text: Whether data samples sit at the left or right of the slot.

fields.name: TXSAME
fields.text: What is sent when the transmitter underruns.

fields.name: TXDEFAULT
fields.text: Level driven on the SDn output pin through every disabled slot.

fields.name: RXLOOP
fields.text: Turns on a loop-back test mode.

values.text: Each receiver takes its input from its own SDn pin; the default.
The receiver takes its input from the transmitter output of the other Serializer of the pair: SD1 for SD0, SD0 for SD1.

fields.name: DMA
fields.text: Whether even- and odd-numbered slots share one DMA channel or each have their own.

values.name: MULTIPLE
values.text: A DMA channel for each data channel.

fields.name: MONO
fields.text: Mono mode.

values.name: MONO
values.text: Left-channel data is copied to the right channel.

fields.name: SLOTDISx
fields.text: One bit per slot x: lets individual slots of each transmit frame be left out.

values.text: Slot x carries no data and is driven as TXDEFAULT sets.

fields.name: BITREV
fields.text: Order of the data bits within the word, set in the Formatting Unit.

fields.name: EXTEND
fields.text: Bit value the Formatting Unit uses to pad out data samples.

fields.name: WORDADJ
fields.text: Whether the Formatting Unit places data samples at the left or right of the word.

fields.name: DATASIZE
fields.text: Bits per data sample. In 8-bit compact stereo two 8-bit samples share bits 15:0 of DATAm; in 16-bit compact stereo two 16-bit samples share bits 31:0 of DATAm.

fields.name: SLOTADJ
fields.text: Whether data samples sit at the left or right of the slot.

fields.name: CLKSEL
fields.text: Which Clock Unit the receiver uses.

fields.name: SERMODE
fields.text: Serializer mode.

values.name: PDM2
values.text: Receive one PDM data bit on each serial clock edge.

fields.name: DATA
fields.text: Data samples to send: what is written here goes to the Tx Serializer through the Transmit Formatting Unit, formatted as TXCTRL sets.

fields.name: DATA
fields.text: Received data samples: what the Rx Serializer takes in is read here, after the Receive Formatting Unit has formatted it as RXCTRL sets.

registers.name: MR
registers.title: PCC Mode Register
notes: Writable only while WPEN in WPMR is 0.

fields.name: CID
fields.text: Clears the status flags when the PCC is disabled, and re-initializes the PCC's internal capture logic on each falling edge of the chosen DEN1 or DEN2 signal, so glitches cannot leave data corrupted or misaligned.

values.text: Clear on a falling edge of DEN1.
Clear on a falling edge of DEN2.
Clear on a falling edge of DEN1 or DEN2.

fields.name: ISIZE
fields.text: Width of the input data bus.

fields.name: FRSTS
fields.text: Matters only when HALFS is 1: with incoming data counted from 0, picks whether the even- or the odd-numbered ones are kept.

fields.name: HALFS
fields.text: Keeps every data item or only every second one. Works the same whatever ALWYS is.

values.text: Every other data item is sampled.

fields.name: ALWYS
fields.text: Samples only while the data enables are active, or all the time.

values.text: Samples when both data enables are active.
Samples all the time, whatever the data enables are.

fields.name: SCALE
fields.text: Scales data to 16 bits.

values.text: When ISIZE is not 0 (input wider than 8 bits), data stored in PCC_RHR is scaled up to 16 bits.

fields.name: DSIZE
fields.text: How many data items each read of PCC_RHR returns.

fields.name: PCEN
fields.text: Turns the Parallel Capture Controller on or off.

fields.name: OVRE
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Overrun Error interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DRDY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns on the Data Ready interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVRE
fields.text: Writing 1 turns off the Overrun Error interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: DRDY
fields.text: Writing 1 turns off the Data Ready interrupt; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVRE
fields.text: Reads whether the Overrun Error interrupt is on.

fields.name: DRDY
fields.text: Reads whether the Data Ready interrupt is on.

fields.name: OVRE
fields.text: Overrun error flag; goes back to 0 when this register is read or the PCC is disabled.

values.text: No overrun since this register was last read.
One or more overruns since this register was last read.

fields.name: DRDY
fields.text: Data ready flag; goes back to 0 when RHR is read or the PCC is disabled.

values.text: Nothing new since RHR was last read.
New data waiting since RHR was last read.

fields.name: RDATA
fields.text: Captured data. The bits that carry data depend on ISIZE, SCALE and DSIZE. 8-bit input: one item in RDATA[7:0], two in RDATA[15:0], four in RDATA[31:0]. 10-, 12- or 14-bit input with SCALE off: one item in RDATA[9:0], [11:0] or [13:0]; two items there and in RDATA[25:16], [27:16] or [29:16]. With SCALE on: one item in RDATA[15:0], two in RDATA[31:0].

fields.name: WPKEY
fields.text: Key that must go with any write of WPEN.

values.name: PASSWD
values.text: The only key that lets WPEN be written; any other value cancels the write. Reads as 0.

fields.name: WPEN
fields.text: Turns write protection on or off, taken only with WPKEY = 0x504343 ("PCC" in ASCII).

values.text: Write protection off, when WPKEY is 0x504343.
Write protection on, when WPKEY is 0x504343.

fields.name: WPVSRC
fields.text: When WPVS is 1, holds the offset of the register a write was tried on.

fields.name: WPVS
fields.text: Write protection violation flag.

values.text: No violation since WPSR was last read.
A violation since WPSR was last read; when it was a write to a protected register, WPVSRC holds where.

fields.name: MAXCMP
fields.text: Limit on missing pulses in a row, used only in the AUTOC configuration of QDEC mode; no effect otherwise. Not synchronized.

fields.name: ANGULAR
fields.text: In QDEC mode, sets how many low bits of COUNT form the Angular counter: ANGULAR + 9 bits. The upper bits left over count revolutions, so 0 gives a 9-bit angle and 7-bit revolution count, and 7 gives a 16-bit angle with no revolution count. No effect outside QDEC mode. Not synchronized.

fields.name: PINVEN
fields.text: One bit per input pin x: 1 inverts the pin's active level. No effect while the matching PINEN bit is 0. In COUNTER mode only bit 0 counts. Not synchronized.

fields.name: PINEN
fields.text: One bit per input x: takes signal x from I/O pin x instead of an event line. In COUNTER mode only PINVEN[0] is significant. Not synchronized.

values.text: Signal comes from the event line.
Signal comes from the I/O pin.

fields.name: PEREN
fields.text: Makes CC0 the counter period. Not synchronized.

fields.name: SWAP
fields.text: Exchanges the input sources of signals 0 and 1 (phases A and B). No effect in COUNTER mode. Not synchronized.

fields.name: ALOCK
fields.text: When 1, hardware sets CTRLB.LUPD on detecting an UPDATE condition. Not synchronized.

fields.name: CONF
fields.text: PDEC configuration; matters only in QDEC mode. Not synchronized.

fields.name: RUNSTDBY
fields.text: Keeps the PDEC running in standby. Not synchronized.

fields.name: MODE
fields.text: Picks QDEC, HALL or COUNTER mode. Not synchronized.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Turns the PDEC on or off. The change takes effect after a synchronization delay: the written value reads back at once, SYNCBUSY.ENABLE goes to 1, and SYNCBUSY.ENABLE returns to 0 when the change is done.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: A 1 returns every PDEC register except DBGCTRL to its reset value and leaves the PDEC disabled; a 0 does nothing. A 1 here wins over every other bit written in the same access, which is dropped. The reset finishes after a synchronization delay, and then CTRLA.SWRST and SYNCBUSY.SWRST both go to 0.

registers.name: CTRLBCLR
registers.title: Control B Clear
notes: Clears CTRLB bits without a read-modify-write; the change shows in CTRLBSET too.

fields.name: CMD
fields.text: Software commands to the PDEC. A command runs on the next prescaled GCLK_PDEC cycle, and CMD reads 0 once it has run. Writing a valid command code here cancels that command while it is pending; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: LUPD
fields.text: Lock Update: while CTRLB.LUPD is 1, a hardware UPDATE condition copies no buffer register into its register, so every buffer can be loaded before they are released together. Writing 1 here releases the lock; writing 0 does nothing.

values.text: On a hardware update, PRESCBUF, FILTERBUF and CCBUFx are copied to their registers (CCx, PER).
On a hardware update, PRESCBUF, FILTERBUF and CCBUFx are not copied.

registers.name: CTRLBSET
registers.title: Control B Set
notes: Sets CTRLB bits without a read-modify-write; the change shows in CTRLBCLR too.

fields.name: CMD
fields.text: Software commands to the PDEC. Writing a valid code issues that command; it runs on the next prescaled GCLK_PDEC cycle, and CMD reads 0 once it has run. Writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: LUPD
fields.text: Lock Update: while CTRLB.LUPD is 1, a hardware UPDATE condition copies no buffer register into its register, so every buffer can be loaded before they are released together. Writing 1 here sets the lock.

values.text: On a hardware update, PRESCBUF, FILTERBUF and CCBUFx are copied to their registers (CCx, PER).
On a hardware update, PRESCBUF, FILTERBUF and CCBUFx are not copied.

fields.name: MCEOx
fields.text: One bit per channel x: sends an event on every compare match of channel x.

values.text: No match event on channel x.
A match event on channel x for every compare match.

fields.name: VLCEO
fields.text: Turns on the velocity event: an event level whenever the qualified PDEC phase inputs change. No effect in COUNTER mode.

values.text: A VLC event for every valid velocity condition.

fields.name: DIREO
fields.text: Turns on the direction event: an event level that shows which way the rotation goes.

values.text: DIR event on; its level changes when the rotation direction changes.

fields.name: ERREO
fields.text: Turns on the error (ERR) event output.

fields.name: OVFEO
fields.text: Turns on the overflow/underflow event, sent when the counter overflows or underflows.

values.text: An event for every counter overflow or underflow.

fields.name: EVEIx
fields.text: One bit per input event x: lets asynchronous event x into the counter.

fields.name: EVINVx
fields.text: One bit per input event x: inverts asynchronous event x going into the counter.

fields.name: EVACT
fields.text: What the counter does on an input event; used only in COUNTER mode, ignored in the others.

registers.name: INTENCLR
registers.title: Interrupt Enable Clear
notes: Clears interrupt enable bits without a read-modify-write; the change shows in INTENSET too.

fields.name: MC
fields.text: One bit per channel x: writing 1 clears the Match Channel x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: VLC
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Velocity interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing. No effect in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Direction Change interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing. No effect in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Error interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Writing 1 clears the Overflow interrupt enable, turning that interrupt off; writing 0 does nothing.

registers.name: INTENSET
registers.title: Interrupt Enable Set
notes: Sets interrupt enable bits without a read-modify-write; the change shows in INTENCLR too.

fields.name: MC
fields.text: One bit per channel x: writing 1 sets the Match Channel x interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: VLC
fields.text: Writing 1 sets the Velocity interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing. No effect in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Writing 1 sets the Direction Change interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing. No effect in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Writing 1 sets the Error interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Writing 1 sets the Overflow interrupt enable, turning that interrupt on; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: MC
fields.text: One bit per channel x: set one CLK_PDEC_CNT cycle after channel x meets its compare condition; raises an interrupt when INTENSET.MCx is 1. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: VLC
fields.text: Set on a velocity transition; raises an interrupt when INTENSET.VLC is 1. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing. Never set in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Set when the direction changes; raises an interrupt when INTENSET.DIR is 1. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing. Never set in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: ERR
fields.text: Set when an error is detected; raises an interrupt when INTENSET.ERR is 1. STATUS shows which error. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: OVF
fields.text: Set one CLK_TC_CNT cycle after an overflow; raises an interrupt when INTENSET.OVF is 1. Writing 1 clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

fields.name: CCBUFV
fields.text: One bit per channel x: goes to 1 when CCBUFx is written; cleared by writing 1 to it or by an UPDATE condition.

fields.name: FILTERBUFV
fields.text: Goes to 1 when FILTERBUF is written; cleared by writing 1 to it or by an UPDATE condition. Reads 0 in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: PRESCBUFV
fields.text: Goes to 1 when PRESCBUF is written; cleared by writing 1 to it or by an UPDATE condition.

fields.name: DIR
fields.text: Rotation direction seen by the HALL/QDEC decoder. Reads 0 in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: STOP
fields.text: Whether HALL/QDEC decoding is running. Reads 0 in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: HERR
fields.text: Set when an invalid HALL code is seen; cleared by writing 1 to it. Reads 0 outside HALL mode.

fields.name: WINERR
fields.text: Set when the counter leaves the monitored window; cleared by writing 1 to it. Reads 0 outside HALL mode.

fields.name: MPERR
fields.text: Set when a missing pulse error is seen; cleared by writing 1 to it. Reads 0 outside QDEC mode.

fields.name: IDXERR
fields.text: Set when an index error is seen; cleared by writing 1 to it. Reads 0 outside QDEC mode.

fields.name: QERR
fields.text: Set when an invalid QDEC transition is seen; cleared by writing 1 to it. Reads 0 outside QDEC mode.

fields.name: DBGRUN
fields.text: Whether the PDEC keeps running while the device is halted for debug. A software reset leaves this bit alone; software should not change it while the PDEC is enabled.

values.text: Halts with the device in debug.
Keeps running while the device is halted in debug.

fields.name: CC
fields.text: One bit per channel x: reads 1 while CCx is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: COUNT
fields.text: Reads 1 while the COUNT register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: FILTER
fields.text: Reads 1 while the FILTER register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done. Reads 0 in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: PRESC
fields.text: Reads 1 while the PRESC register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: STATUS
fields.text: Reads 1 while the STATUS register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: CTRLB
fields.text: Reads 1 while the CTRLB register is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.text: Reads 1 while the ENABLE bit is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: SWRST
fields.text: Reads 1 while the SWRST bit is being carried across the clock domains, and goes back to 0 once that is done.

fields.name: PRESC
fields.text: Division applied to the GCLK.

fields.name: FILTER
fields.text: Length of the filter on the PDEC inputs. No effect in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: PRESCBUF
fields.text: Buffered prescaler value; copied into PRESC on an UPDATE condition.

fields.name: FILTERBUF
fields.text: Buffered filter value; copied into FILTER on an UPDATE condition. No effect in COUNTER mode.

fields.name: COUNT
fields.text: The counter value. For the latest value, issue the READSYNC command (CTRLBSET.CMD = READSYNC) before reading.

fields.name: CC
fields.text: Compare value of channel x.

fields.name: CCBUF
fields.text: Buffer for compare register CCx of channel x. A CPU access to it affects STATUS.CCBUFVx.
